logo.wordmark: lowercase 'lumen' + accent-light 'labs', built in HTML — never an image
lockupRules: never rotate, skew, or distort the mark
never recolor the mark to a hue outside the accent ramp
no bevel / inner-shadow / glow filter ON the mark (light goes in a halo behind it)
keep clear space ≥ the height of the notch on all sides

type.accentWord: exactly one serif-italic accent word, tinted var(--accent-light)

do: confident, technical, no fluff — talk like engineers
dont: no emoji in finished brand copy

lexicon.ship: prefer over 'launch/release' for a builder voice

negatives: text, letters, words, numbers, captions, watermark, logo, signature
people, faces, hands, bodies, real objects, devices, screens
any hue outside the accent ramp + neutral; no rainbow gradient
bevels, glossy 3D, heavy lens flare, busy collage, clutter
